Secure Note Vault

Store notes encrypted with real AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2 password key). Genuinely encrypted at rest.

Your password is never stored — only the encrypted ciphertext is kept in this browser.

Vault

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a strong vault password (it is never stored).
  2. Give the note a title and write its content.
  3. Click Save Encrypted Note — only ciphertext is stored.
  4. Click Unlock Vault with your password to read notes.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the encryption real?

Yes. Each note is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your password via PBKDF2 (100,000 SHA-256 iterations) with a random salt. Only ciphertext is stored.

What if I forget my password?

No. Your password never leaves the page and is never stored. Wrong password = failed decryption, and there is no recovery.

Can I access notes on another device?

You can unlock the vault with the password on any device, but the encrypted notes are stored per-browser — paste the ciphertext to the other device manually.

How do I use it?

Enter your password, give the note a title, write it, and click Save Encrypted Note. Use Unlock Vault to decrypt and view.
